title: Update retries/timeouts docs with consistent Python/TS/Go examples + migration note links
author: Wei Chen
description: Context: As part of the SDK parity initiative (auth/retry/timeout/streaming), our docs had drift across languages and in some cases recommended different defaults/knobs than the SDKs actually expose. This PR updates the public docs to (1) present a single retry/timeout mental model, (2) use the same configuration option names across Python/TypeScript/Go snippets, and (3) link prominently to the migration notes for customers upgrading. Changes in this PR: - Update the main "Retries & timeouts" page to reflect the v1 standard: retryable status codes (408, 429, 5xx), network/transport errors, and honoring Retry-After (both delta-seconds and HTTP date). - Add a consistent defaults table (max attempts, initial/max backoff, timeout model) and call out streaming constraints (no automatic retry after partial output). - Replace language-specific example blocks with aligned examples showing: (a) client-wide defaults, (b) per-request override, (c) how to log request_id + retry_count for support. - Add links to the migration guide and explicitly name the minimum SDK versions that include the standardized behavior (Python >= 1.12, TS >= 0.28, Go >= 0.19). - Add a short troubleshooting section used by Support macros: how to collect request_id, sdk version, and effective retry/timeout settings. Not included: no changes to SDK implementations or API gateway behavior (those are in ENG-5123/24/25/5130). References: - Retry/timeout standard: internal Confluence "SDK retry/timeout standard" - Timeout ADR: "ADR: SDK timeout model" - Retry ADR: "ADR: SDK retry policy v1" - Migration notes: /docs/sdk/migration/auth-retry-timeout (published separately, linked here) Screenshots: N/A (text-only).
commits: docs(sdk): unify retry policy language + add Retry-After parsing details
docs(sdk): add consistent timeout model table + per-request override examples
docs(examples): align Python/TS/Go snippets to shared option names
docs(migration): add prominent links + version gates for standardized behavior
docs(troubleshooting): add request_id + retry_count logging guidance for support
conversation: Elliot Price (review): The structure looks good. Two nits: (1) can we avoid implying we retry on all 5xx forever? Please be explicit about max attempts/defaults. (2) In TS snippet, show AbortController interaction for per-request timeout (since we had issues with streaming cancellation).

Wei Chen (author): Updated the defaults table to explicitly call out max_attempts=3 by default and added a note that callers can raise/lower. Also added a TS per-request override example that uses the SDK's timeout option (not raw AbortController) and included a callout on how cancellation behaves for streaming vs non-streaming.

Allison Grant (review): Please add a one-liner on backoff jitter semantics so SRE doesn't get questions during rollout. Something like 'exponential backoff with jitter; respect Retry-After when present'. Also please ensure we mention 429 uses Retry-After delta-seconds OR date format.

Wei Chen (author): Done. Added a short 'Backoff behavior' section: exponential backoff with jitter, caps at max_backoff, and Retry-After wins when present. Also clarified we accept both formats (seconds + HTTP date) and that SDKs clamp unreasonable values.

Sabrina James (review): Python snippet currently uses timeout_ms but the Python SDK uses Timeout(...) with connect/read/overall. Can we show both? At least show the overall case + mention granular fields exist.

Wei Chen (author): Updated Python example to show overall timeout_ms for the common case and added a follow-up block that shows connect_timeout_ms/read_timeout_ms/overall_timeout_ms fields. Also ensured the narrative matches the ADR: granular fields map to the underlying client where supported.

Dana Lo (review): Minor wording: 'retries on 408' is correct, but please add that 409 is NOT retried by default (we had a customer concern around duplicates). Also link the migration guide right next to the code blocks (not only at top).

Wei Chen (author): Added explicit 'Non-retryable by default' list including 400/401/403/404/409 and validation errors, plus a reminder about idempotency keys. Also added inline migration links below each language block.
Monica Patel (approval): This matches the parity initiative. Please ensure the minimum versions listed match the release plan (Python 1.12, TS 0.28, Go 0.19).
Wei Chen (author): Confirmed with Ibrahim; versions updated and called out as 'or later'.
Henry Cho (approval): Looks good—thank you for keeping the messaging non-alarming. The 'what changes for existing users' callout is concise.
Elliot Price (final): Approving. Netlify preview looks clean; links resolve.
release_notes: Docs: Retries & timeouts documentation now shows consistent configuration and defaults across Python/TypeScript/Go.
Docs: Added prominent migration guide links and clarified streaming retry guidance (no automatic retry after partial output).
Docs: Added troubleshooting guidance for request_id, retry_count, and timeout settings to support faster triage.
